page.layout: One column of running text, no margin notes. Printed page number and running head at the top; catchword "cap." at the lower right.

main_text.p: Argum. l. 3. D. de Just. & Jur. & l. 3. Cod. eod. Sic ut in adversa-rium, eam non esse factam in continenti, sit conferenda pro-batio. Berlich. part. 4. concl. 13. n. 52. Ita vim adhibitam esse pro defensione probari ab occidente oportet. Arg. dd. ll. & l. 1. Cod. l. Cornel. de Sicar. Arg. l. 5. Cod. de Injur. Metzger. Consil. crim. 8. num. 10. Berlich. art. 4. conclus. 14. n. 1. ibidemque auctores citati. wißenb. disp. 3. Pand. num. 10. In dubiis tamen [?] præ-sumendum eam ad defensionem esse factam, ut saltem ordinariæ legis Corneliæ pœnæ locus esse non debeat. In pœ-nalibus enim mitior est facien-da interpretatio, præsertim si probabiles quædam conjectu-ræ militent pro reo. l. 5, l. 42. D. de Pœn. Martin. Uran, Tom. 2. Consil. 26. num. 5. Idque conforme esse constitutioni crimi-nali Carolinæ innuit Gilhauf. cap.

page.notes: The overprinted line "num. 10. In dubiis tamen" is partly obscured by a strike-through or show-through; "dubiis tamen" is a doubtful reading. The spelling "wißenb." is as printed. The first word of the page starts flush left and may continue from the previous page.
